why: The value on day i is max(prefix sum up to i, suffix sum from i). So the answer is just the largest prefix sum or suffix sum: two running-sum scans, one from each end.
hints: Write the day-i value with sums: one is a prefix sum ending at i, the other a suffix sum starting at i.
The maximum over days of max(prefix_i, suffix_i) equals max(the largest prefix sum, the largest suffix sum).
One left-to-right running sum and one right-to-left running sum, tracking the best value seen. O(n) time, O(1) space.
pitfalls: All values negative: the answer is negative, so don't start the best value at 0.
Sums reach 10^14; fine in Python, use long in other languages.
Day i's own change is counted in both sums.
